name: Capture and desktop isolation
required: Use two desktops, distinct fixture windows and a pinned window. Verify active-only capture, correct membership, exclusion of BranchWatch and unrelated windows; check minimized/maximized windows are listed but not executable.

name: Exact restoration and repeat
required: Capture Default fixture at a normal position; move it; restore and repeat. Verify exact bounds, AlreadyPlaced, no extra instances and unrelated window unchanged.

name: Selective restore
required: Select one of two distinct fixture windows and leave the other unselected. Verify only the selected window moves, unchecked app never launches, and progress/results reflect selection.

name: Ambiguous identities
required: Use two fixture instances with identical titles; verify neither ambiguous window moves or launches, even with only one selected.

name: Cold reboot and launch
required: Save a single Default fixture snapshot, record before, restart Windows, verify no auto-restore, manually launch the qualification build, opt in to missing-app launch, restore, and verify bounds and repeat behavior.

name: Physical monitor rearrangement
required: Rearrange displays in Windows while keeping hardware connected. Refresh and verify windows follow matched physical identities, not source names.

name: Mixed DPI and portrait
required: Use at least two monitors with different scale factors and a portrait display. Verify proportional preview and actual bounds, no double scaling and accessible results.

name: Disconnected monitor fallback
required: Capture with secondary connected, disconnect it, verify default skip and explicit fallback selection; restore and verify windows remain accessible.

name: Spanning window and display gaps
required: Capture a spanning normal window; verify unchanged span, then change layout to create a gap and confirm review-required single-monitor fit.

name: Stale preview, desktop change and cancellation
required: Change topology after preview, change desktop during restore, cancel during placement/launch; verify stale plan refusal and no subsequent requests, no rollback promises.

name: Launch and identity safeguards
required: Exercise launch disabled, already-running app on another desktop, duplicate saved windows, wrong title/delegation, missing executable and failed/timeout correlation. Verify no duplicate launches or unrelated moves.

name: Application folder adapters
required: Test installed Cursor, VS Code, Explorer and Windows Terminal using disposable folders with spaces. Verify approval target, missing folder blocking, direct correlation and brokered unverified results. Record unavailable adapters as Blocked.

name: Persistence and recovery
required: Use disposable desktop snapshots. Verify explicit save/replace/discard/delete, persistence across restart, stale/corrupt file refusal using a backed-up test copy, and no unintended writes.

name: WPF UI and existing features
required: Check keyboard navigation, narrow Settings, mixed scaling, selection controls, cancellation/close, progress, Git watcher, desktop overlay and sticky notes.

name: Chrome profile capture and reopening
required: Complete Chrome native parent correlation and Companion capture/reopen guides with two identical-position windows, two profiles, two desktops, mixed DPI, duplicate URLs, pinned/active metadata, wrong code/profile/window/desktop, selection, expiry and replay. Verify no unrelated window or tab changes and record actual browser version and evidence paths.

name: Edge profile capture and reopening
required: Repeat the Chromium correlation and Companion capture/reopen checks in Edge, including different profiles, desktops, identical bounds, permission denial, host mismatch, stale code, tab review and protected persistence.

name: Browser duplicate and uncertain outcomes
required: In Chrome and Edge exercise native browser session restore, exact match, partial overlap, another desktop, pending/redirected URL, changed inventory and changed source focus. Confirm no duplicate creation on overlap or unverified inventory and no existing-tab modifications or blind retries. Document partial or uncertain outcomes.

name: Protected snapshot migration and recovery
required: In a disposable Windows account only, test legacy primary and backup, read-only load, explicit migration, mixed legacy/protected pair retry, save/delete, same-user restart, and manual recovery from protected backup. Verify schema 2 envelopes contain no readable snapshot fields and preserve expected generations. Never use irreplaceable data.

name: Protected snapshot account isolation
required: Using only disposable Windows accounts, copy a synthetic protected primary/backup to the second account's test data folder. Verify read, migration and overwrite fail and copied hashes remain unchanged. Return to the original account, verify same-user read and before/after probes. Do not transfer DPAPI keys or use real snapshots.

name: Firefox diagnostic-only boundary
required: With Firefox Companion 0.2.1, verify hello and diagnostic challenge remain diagnostic-only, Firefox URL capture/restore actions cannot be armed, and no new tab permissions or snapshot changes occur. Record qualification results separately using the Firefox physical guide; this case is not authorization for live Firefox.

name: Companion installation and upgrade lifecycle
required: Use disposable profiles. Check current extension/host setup, restart, unregister/re-register, missing host, invalid extension ID, denied optional tabs permission, and no unrelated registry changes. Verify updated Companion 0.4.1 is loaded in each Chrome/Edge test profile. Inspect logs for absence of raw URL payloads.
